business_problem: Lombard Odier needed to modernize its legacy banking infrastructure, reduce technical complexity, and accelerate innovation while maintaining security and regulatory compliance.
solution_summary: Lombard Odier needed to modernize its legacy banking infrastructure, reduce technical complexity, and accelerate innovation while maintaining security and regulatory compliance. The bank leveraged MongoDB Modernization Factory and Gen AI to migrate from SQL, modernize its Java-based systems, and automate testing, significantly accelerating its transformation. Leveraging MongoDB AI Modernization Solutions Building on a 10-year relationship with MongoDB, Lombard Odier chose the data platform provider for its transformation. After discussing the bank's initiative, MongoDB recommended leveraging MongoDB's modernization services, which combines advanced gen AI tools and MongoDB expertise to accelerate the application modernization process. MongoDB’s ability to scale was key to this system migration. The bank then decided to go a step further and worked with MongoDB to use gen AI on a marketing application called “Publications” to accelerate the code migration.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Lombard Odier's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include CRM systems, APIs.
business_outcome: 50–60x faster code migration 20x faster small app migrations Regression testing reduced from 3 days to 3 hours
metrics: Lombard Odier also started to migrate more than 250 applications from its existing Java application server to the bank’s next-generation framework.
